macros.name: xintBezout
macros.doc: \xintBezout{N}{M} returns three numbers U, V, D within braces where D is the (non-negative) GCD, and UN + VM = D.

macros.name: xintBezoutAlgorithm
macros.doc: \xintBezoutAlgorithm{N}{M} applies the Euclide algorithm and keeps a copy of all quotients and remainders.

macros.name: xintEuclideAlgorithm
macros.doc: \xintEuclideAlgorithm{N}{M} applies the Euclide algorithm and keeps a copy of all quotients and remainders.
